$comment: Allowlist for scripts/ci/token-audit.sh (#780): every secrets.* name a workflow under .github/workflows may reference. GITHUB_TOKEN is exempt (installation token, not a repository secret). Rotate, then update `rotated`; the audit warns after 90 days. Values are never read.

secrets.name: AI_TEAM_BLOCKED_BY_SWEEP_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Shared-user PAT for the cross-repo Blocked-By sweep, used only until the AI Team GitHub App is configured (#621).

secrets.name: AI_TEAM_GITHUB_APP_ID
secrets.purpose: AI Team GitHub App id; mints installation tokens for the Blocked-By sweep and the independent review gate (#621).

secrets.name: AI_TEAM_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: AI Team GitHub App private key; mints installation tokens for the Blocked-By sweep and the independent review gate (#621).

secrets.name: COVERAGE_BASELINE_RAISE_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Temporary operator PAT: opens/labels maintenance PRs and lands bot-maintenance PRs, because org policy refuses GITHUB_TOKEN createPullRequest (#686, #755).

secrets.name: PEOPLE_CONNECTOR_DISPATCH_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Dispatches the verified platform revision to the people-connector compatibility workflow after a green main push.

secrets.name: SONAR_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: SonarCloud scanner token for the platform and Domain CI scans.
